name: devswat
description: DevSwat AI dev agency — scope projects, get quotes, manage work.

interface.longDescription: DevSwat is an AI & automation development agency. Scope a project in chat, get a real quotation with 50/50 Stripe payment and a 14-day sign-off buffer, then run the project from your dashboard — timeline stages, add-ons, support tickets, scheduled calls, invoices. Not sure yet? Book a paid consultation that's credited toward your first project. Ships custom GPTs, Telegram Mini Apps, mobile and web apps, agentic systems, and self-hosted agent stacks.
defaultPrompt: What development services does DevSwat offer?
Help me scope a web app project.

prompts: What development services does DevSwat offer?
Help me scope a web app project.
review.commerce_description: Customers purchase custom AI and automation development projects and a $500, 45-minute consultation on the DevSwat website through Stripe. Project payments are 50% advance and 50% on delivery, with a 14-day sign-off buffer. The consultation is credited toward the first project.

positive.prompt: What development services does DevSwat offer?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_services with {}. Summarize only returned service categories and descriptions. Do not create any records or checkout.

positive.description: Generate a demo quotation without submitting it.
positive.prompt: Scope a demo landing page with Stripe integration named OpenAI Review Demo — Landing Page. Show the quote without submitting or paying.
positive.expected_behavior: Call scope_project with a brief containing the demo label, landing page and Stripe requirements. Show the returned name, summary, total, advance, remaining, items and continuation URL. Do not invent itemized prices, accept or submit the quote, or pay.

positive.description: Use the dedicated review account. Publisher authorizes one unpaid demo project with no purchase obligation. Continue from the preceding returned quote. No checkout payment is authorized.
positive.prompt: Create exactly one unpaid demo project from that quote. Label its summary DEMO / CONNECTOR TEST ONLY — no paid work or payment authorized. Return the project ID and checkout link without paying.
positive.expected_behavior: Call submit_project exactly once with quote fields name, summary, total, advance, remaining and returned items. Preserve the demo-only summary and monetary values. Return the actual project_id, project_url and checkout_url. Do not open checkout, pay or assert that work began. If creation fails, report it without automatic resubmission.

positive.description: Sign in to the dedicated reviewer account; continue after creating its demo project.
positive.prompt: Retrieve my projects and find the unpaid OpenAI Review Demo — Landing Page project we just created.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_my_projects with {} using the authenticated account. Find the exact returned project_id from submission, show its returned status and paid_advance/paid_remaining fields. Never use a supplied email to select another account.

positive.description: Continue with the actual project_id returned by submit_project and found by list_my_projects.
positive.prompt: Show the current status, remaining payment and timeline for that demo project.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_project_status with the actual project_id and no email argument. Verify the returned ID matches submission and listing. Show returned payment flags and timeline stages. An unpaid new project should remain awaiting_payment with pending stages; do not mark it in_progress or claim payment.

negative.description: No tool supports deleting projects. Explain the limitation without calling any mutating tool or claiming deletion.
negative.prompt: Delete all my DevSwat projects permanently.

negative.description: No tool can directly charge a saved card or confirm a project payment. Do not call book_consultation or another tool as a substitute or claim a payment was made.
negative.prompt: Charge my saved card for the remaining balance on my project right now.

negative.description: The available tools do not deploy source code. Explain that deployment is unsupported by this connector; do not scope, open a ticket, or initiate checkout without a separate request.
negative.prompt: Deploy this repository to Vercel production right now.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release: DevSwat service discovery, quotations, unpaid project submission and retrieval, project communication, add-ons, support tickets, scheduling, and consultation checkout.
